Title: Successful Admin Authentication
Steps: 1. Enter valid username\n2. Enter valid password\n3. Click Login
Expected Result: 1. User is authenticated\n2. Redirected to Dashboard\n3. Page title is 'Dashboard'

Title: Authentication Failure (Invalid Credentials)
Steps: 1. Enter invalid credential combinations (Valid U/Inv P, Inv U/Valid P, Inv U/Inv P, Unreg U)\n2. Click Login
Expected Result:
1. Login fails
2. Remains on Login page
3. Displays 'Invalid credentials'
4. No session created

Title: Mandatory Field Validation (Empty/Whitespace)
Steps: 1. Leave Username or Password empty/whitespace\n2. Click Login
Expected Result: 1. No API request sent\n2. 'Required' message appears under the empty field(s)

Title: System Error Handling (API 500)
Steps: 1. Enter valid credentials\n2. Simulate API 500 error\n3. Click Login

Title: Non-standard Format Input
Steps: 1. Enter username with special characters\n2. Enter valid password\n3. Click Login
Expected Result: System validates login based on registered account regardless of character format
